A 2-D grid of terminal cells with immutable mutation semantics.

static new(int $width, int $height): selfDefault factory — creates a width×height grid of blank cells.

One allocation per cell, not one Buffer clone per write.
toBuilder(): BufferBuilderMutable scratch seeded with this buffer's cells, for repainting an existing frame in bulk. Writes follow the same pair law as withCellAt(), and BufferBuilder::toBuffer() on the result equals the immutable chain over the same writes; this buffer is not changed.

diff(Buffer $previous): arrayCompare this buffer against $previous and return the list of operations needed to transform $previous into this buffer.

BufferBuilder final class

Mutable scratch pad for BULK cell painting (CB-34).

MethodSummary
__construct(private readonly int $width, private readonly int $height, ?array $seed = null)A seed grid is validated BEFORE the canvas is allocated, so a mismatched or hostile seed fails with InvalidArgumentException instead of first building a blank grid of the requested size next to it.
static fromGrid(int $width, int $height, array $grid): selfSeed a builder with an existing flat grid, so a frame that already exists can be repainted in place. Buffer::toBuilder() is the in-tree caller; validation lives in the constructor.
setCellAt(int $col, int $row, Cell $cell): selfPaint one cell with the full pair law applied in place. Bounds are fatal (Out Of Range) exactly as withCellAt(), not silently clipped — a bulk loop hitting the edge is a caller bug the builder refuses to hide.
fillRect(Region $region, Cell $cell): selfSweep a region with one cell, clipped to the builder extent (the same intersect-then-sweep shape as Buffer::fill(), which likewise never throws for out-of-frame regions).
width(): intWidth in cells.
height(): intHeight in cells.
region(): RegionBounding region of the entire canvas.
toBuffer(): BufferFreeze the CURRENT grid into an immutable Buffer via the validated fromGrid wrap. Repeat calls after further painting each snapshot the grid as it stands.

withFg(?int $fg): selfSets the RGB foreground and discards palette-slot identity (the two representations are mutually exclusive by this class's with*() law).

equals(self $other): boolValue equality: two styles are equal iff their fg, bg, attrs, palette slots, and underline colour values are all identical.
static valuesEqual(?self $a, ?self $b): boolNull-safe value equality: two optional styles are the same render state iff both are null, or both are non-null and value-equal.
toAnsi(): stringOne-shot full SGR emission for this style (CB-31): the exact bytes the diff encoder writes whenever its pen transitions onto it — the canonical emitter (Support\SgrEmitter, relocated in CB-30) is the single home, so this is the parse→emit identity surface for callers outside a Buffer stream. Note the leading reset term: emission is assertive (\x1b[0;…m), self-contained on any terminal state.
static fromSgr(string $params, ?self $carry = null): ?selfParse one SGR parameter run (the digits between "\x1b[" and 'm') into a Style, carried on top of $carry.

WidePairPlacement trait

The wide-pair placement law, shared verbatim by Buffer's copy-on-write paths and the mutable BufferBuilder scratch (CB-34) so the degradation rules exist in exactly one place — a builder that diverged from withCellAt() would mint grids the immutable API can never produce.
